title: the librarian's ChatSession reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: The librarian's ChatSession (cairn/devices/librarian/chat.py:253) reaches DiagnosticBase, so the every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve reads the librarian green.
why: Ticket 339a45cee6a1 (Akien 2026-10-27): every class with code inherits the mixin. Measured 2026-11-11: build_inspector refused 8b16f3e77013's PROVED crossing on exactly this one finding.
how: One edit in chat.py as 668c8d64b4e2 did for the tester, plus a proof modelled on cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

clauses.claim: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_every_librarian_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py greens: the sieve returns no findings for component librarian
ChatSession is a DiagnosticBase, a fresh session's page() returns its tree and an empty transcript, and cairn.devices.librarian.chat imports in a fresh interpreter

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/devices/librarian/chat.py import DiagnosticBase from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic beside the other cairn.tools.base imports; change 'class ChatSession:' to 'class ChatSession(DiagnosticBase):' and make super().__init__() the first line of its __init__. No other body change.

D2: create cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_every_librarian_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py with the tester proof's check/FAILURES/TEETH/main shape, every import inside its tooth; PROVES = {'8c185173269a': {'1': 'test_the_sieve_reads_the_librarian_green', '2': 'test_the_session_reaches_the_mixin_and_keeps_its_behaviour'}}. Tooth 2 builds ChatSession(resolve=lambda *a, **k: None, tree='t') and checks isinstance DiagnosticBase and page() == {'tree': 't', 'turns': []}, then imports chat in a fresh interpreter.

measured.saw: every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin over cairn/devices/librarian: 1 finding, chat.py:253 ChatSession
